lead: Saturday's heavyweight was [CNN's report that the US military nearly intercepted a Chinese ship](../summaries/d9044257d7d1.md) after an AI-assisted intelligence report falsely said the vessel carried nuclear-weapons components. Security ran through the day: [Hacktron chained two vulnerabilities into OpenAI's community forum and identity infrastructure](../summaries/4f60b8959b83.md), and [OpenAI introduced Astra for Law](../summaries/61203371aa12.md). On the model front, [Cactus Needle 3 packed automation models into 8-29MB binaries](../summaries/307dafbc9d60.md), [Artificial Analysis benchmarked StepFun's Step 5 Preview](../summaries/07a310a36693.md) among the leaders, and [NASA and IBM released an open Lunar Foundation Model](../summaries/fccd3a002555.md).
